name: Meeting Organizer
summary: A company employee who runs meetings and needs the raw transcript turned into a concrete follow-up list.
description: Runs or is responsible for a meeting and needs its transcript turned into something actionable afterward, without manually re-reading the whole thing. Uses meeting-notes.process to extract action items (with owner and due date), decisions, and standalone follow-up threads from the transcript -- including handling a routine status-update meeting with no actionable content by returning empty results rather than erroring, since not every meeting produces action items.

distinguished_from.how: Works with meeting transcripts, not vendor documents (invoices, purchase orders) -- a different internal workflow and a different capability entirely.
Extracts action items and decisions from a meeting transcript; does not review or approve vendor documents -- a different internal workflow and a different capability entirely.
